description:
[Game reference] Healing, comfort and heat sources, food/water drain, radiation, fall damage - from the code. Everything on https://rust.wiki/survival-mechanics. `k`: the constants read from the decompiled game code (heal
conditions `heal_*`, drains, temperature, wetness, bleeding, radiation `rad_*`, fall damage `fall_*`, gravity).
`limits`: the player's metabolism ranges. `heal`: HP/s by calories and comfort for a 100 HP player. `drain`:
calories and water per minute by activity. `comfort`: every comfort source (`comfort` 0-1, `full_within` and
`zero_at` metres, `radius`, `kind` deployable / map-placed / monument, `count` in the files). `heat`: every heat,
cold and shade source (`temperature`, `full_within`, `radius`; `shade` rows cool by `shade_cools` in daylight).
`falls`: damage at common heights (awake player, estimated gravity - see calculate_fall_damage). Use section= to keep it short (healing, comfort, heat, food, fall). Link https://rust.wiki/survival-mechanics.

section.description: Only one part: healing, comfort, heat, food, fall or constants.
